feedback.worked_solution:
For a plane lamina in the shape of a region $D$ with mass $M$ and mass density function $\lambda (x,y),$ the radius of gyration ${R}_{y}$ about the $y$-axis is given by

$$
{R}_{y}=\sqrt{\frac{{I}_{y}}{M}},
$$

where ${I}_{y}$ is the moment of inertia about the $y$-axis.

In part 1, we found that the mass of the plate is

$$
M=24.
$$

Also, from part 5, we know that the moment of inertia of the lamina about the $y$-axis is 

$$
{I}_{y}=108.
$$

Therefore, the radius of gyration about the $y$-axis is

$$
\begin{aligned}{R}_{y} & =\sqrt{\frac{{I}_{y}}{M}} \\  & =\sqrt{\frac{108}{24}} \\  & =\sqrt{\frac{9}{2}} \\  & =\frac{3}{\sqrt{2}}\end{aligned}
$$
